Name: PS3 SELF executable
Description: PS3 SELF executable. The built-in scanner parses the SELF header for a better size when available.

Name: ELF executable
Description: ELF executable often used by PS3 tooling and payloads.

Name: PS3 PUP update
Description: PS3 update package header.

Name: PARAM SFO
Description: PS3 PARAM.SFO metadata. The built-in scanner estimates the record table size.

Name: PS3 Trophy Package
Description: PS3 trophy package header.

Name: PS3 NPD EDAT SDAT
Description: PS3 NPD container used by EDAT/SDAT content. The built-in scanner can classify EDAT versus SDAT from the header byte.

Name: Xbox 360 XEX0 executable
Description: Xbox 360 XEX executable variant. The built-in scanner parses the security header for size.

Name: Xbox 360 XEX? executable
Description: Xbox 360 XEX executable variant. The built-in scanner parses the security header for size.

Name: Xbox 360 XEX- executable
Description: Xbox 360 XEX executable variant. The built-in scanner parses the security header for size.

Name: Xbox 360 XEX% executable
Description: Xbox 360 XEX executable variant. The built-in scanner parses the security header for size.

Name: Xbox 360 XEX1 executable
Description: Xbox 360 XEX executable variant. The built-in scanner parses the security header for size.

Name: Xbox 360 XEX2 executable
Description: Xbox 360 XEX executable variant. The built-in scanner parses the security header for size.

Name: Original Xbox XBE
Description: Original Xbox executable. The built-in scanner reads the XBE size and debug filename when available.

Name: Xbox 360 LIVE package
Description: Xbox 360 STFS LIVE package.

Name: Xbox 360 PIRS package
Description: Xbox 360 STFS PIRS package.

Name: Xbox 360 CON package
Description: Xbox 360 STFS CON package.

Name: Xbox Map
Description: Xbox map file with head/foot markers. The built-in scanner validates the declared map size.

Name: Xbox One Series XVD
Description: XVD/XVC container. The visible marker is MSFT-XVD at container offset 0x200; the built-in scanner classifies the XVD type byte and display name when available.

Name: Xbox One Series XVI
Description: XVI/XVC metadata container signature.

Name: Microsoft PDB
Description: Microsoft Program Database symbols. The built-in scanner calculates size from block count.

Name: Portable Executable
Description: MZ/PE executable. The built-in scanner validates the PE header and section table.

Name: PNG image
Description: PNG image. The built-in scanner walks chunks to find IEND.

Name: RIFF container
Description: RIFF family container such as WAV/AVI. The built-in scanner reads the RIFF length field.

Name: ZIP container
Description: ZIP-like local file header. Also catches some package formats that are ZIP containers.

Name: DDS texture
Description: DirectDraw Surface texture.

Name: Bink video
Description: Bink video stream. The built-in scanner reads the BIK size field.

Name: WAV RIFF audio
Description: WAV file, represented as RIFF with WAVE at offset 8.
